caption: LUM-1367 narrow-footer budget: a real 44x14 PTY against the real release binary. The whole footer is 72 columns (model 15 + session 26 + usage 12 + gauge 7 + hint 12), so at 44 the budgeted layout has to give parts up. Before LUM-1367 the positional clip stranded the first character of `in 0 out 0` at the right edge — this frame read `Faux test model  session-<id>  i`. The `reject` rows below are that orphan and its 46/52/70-column siblings; the `expect` rows are the whole parts that replace them. Footer row is the last row (y=13).

expect.why: the composer keeps its row on a 14-row terminal
dropping the session id (26 columns) buys back the complete usage total and context gauge, and the trailing `…` says the bar is showing a subset

reject.why: the pre-fix orphan endings measured in a real PTY: `  i` at 44, `  in` at 46, `  in 0 out` at 52. A hard FAIL if the positional clip comes back.
the 70-column orphan (`  ? for he`): a hint cut after two characters is worse than no hint plus a marker.
at 44 columns the widest part (the session id) is the one the budget gives up; if it reappears here the budget stopped working

panels.label: 2. a draft still edits after the footer gave parts up

expect.why: the composer is unaffected by the footer's budget
the footer is stable across frames: only the draft changed
